Variant feature (World of Warcraft). When you summon a primal beast with your Primal Companion feature, you choose its form among the pet families of the table below. Each family has three characteristics.

Stat Block. The family determines which stat block the beast uses: Beast of the Land, Beast of the Sea, or Beast of the Sky.

Specialization (Spec.). Each family has a specialization—Cunning (C), Ferocity (F), or Tenacity (T)—which matters only if you have the Pet Specialization feature.

Mastery Property (Mastery). When you gain the Primal Companion feature and whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can choose your pet's family as one of the weapons of your Weapon Mastery feature; its mastery property then applies to your companion's Beast's Strike.
